jobs.title: Manager, Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical, across all levels of team leads. As a manager, you will lead a team of product managers, mentoring them to ensure their success while driving alignment with company goals. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.

We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.

Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives.

We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:

  • Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement
  • Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem
  • IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics
  • Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD
  • Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs
  • Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics
  • Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434
  • Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms

If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.

Location: These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone.

This role entails

  • Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales
  • Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track
  • Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities
  • Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations
  • Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training
  • Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings
  • Guide and mentor a team of product managers, helping them grow in their roles and succeed in their projects
  • Oversee the work of multiple product lines, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across your team
  • Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within your team and across other departments

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic results at high school and university
  • Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community
  • Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices
  • Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape
  • A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement
  • Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning
  • A strong sense of ownership
  • Problem solving and the ability to innovate
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written
  • For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry
  • Proven experience in managing and mentoring product managers or cross-functional teams
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that we value

  • Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive)
  • Familiarity with the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channel
  • Familiarity with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker containers & Snaps
  • Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems
  • Experience in managing distributed teams across different time zones
  • Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and innovation in team settings

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Salesforce
jobs.jd_full:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Product Manager to join our Business Information Systems (BIS) team. This individual will drive the vision, roadmap, and execution of enterprise capabilities supporting our Product Business Systems (PBS), with a focus on product configuration, pricing, fulfillment, software provisioning, entitlements, usage, and overage management.

This role will support Kaseya’s current operating environment while helping shape the future-state architecture and processes needed to support continued growth and transformation. PBS capabilities span multiple platforms, including Salesforce, NetSuite, integrations, and Kaseya products such as Kaseya One. As Kaseya evolves its enterprise systems landscape, this individual will help guide the transition toward a scalable architecture anchored by Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, and related applications.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle within an enterprise SaaS environment, including product and pricing configuration, bundle management, software license provisioning, entitlement management, and usage-based billing. This person must be comfortable navigating complex integrations, balancing competing priorities, and partnering across business and technical teams to simplify legacy processes, strengthen controls, and deliver scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and manage the product roadmap for Product and Pricing, Fulfillment, and Provisioning capabilities, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, revenue operations priorities, finance transformation goals, customer experience improvements, and future-state migration objectives.
  • Product and Pricing Management: Lead capabilities related to product configuration, catalog management, SKU creation, product hierarchies, master data governance, pricing models, discount management, renewal pricing, promotions, and bundle configuration.
  • Fulfillment and Provisioning: Drive requirements and solutions for automated, manual, and hybrid provisioning models, fulfillment routing, tenant and instance creation, customer-to-tenant mapping, license provisioning, and entitlement lifecycle management.
  • Lead-to-Cash Lifecycle: Lead requirements definition and solution alignment across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, including product and pricing setup, order fulfillment, provisioning, usage capture, overage management, billing, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Product Ownership and Agile Delivery: Own and manage the product backlog, develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, discovery sessions, solution reviews, demonstrations, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Systems and Integration Management: Serve as a subject matter expert across current and future-state platforms, including Salesforce, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kaseya One, and related applications. Partner with technical teams to ensure reliable integrations and consistent data flows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and IT to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, resolve issues, and deliver scalable business outcomes.
  • Business Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, clarify ownership, improve operational handoffs, strengthen governance, and increase automation across PBS capabilities.
  • Transformation and Migration Readiness: Balance support for legacy systems with future-state transformation priorities, ensuring legacy enhancements deliver measurable value, reduce operational risk, or improve migration readiness.
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance: Ensure solutions align with enterprise policies, internal controls, data privacy, and security requirements. Maintain clear documentation of requirements, business rules, integration dependencies, decisions, testing coverage, and operational readiness.
  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor system performance, user adoption, data quality, defect trends, billing accuracy, provisioning effectiveness, and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement and scalability.
  • Delivery and Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with Engineering Leads, QA, Scrum Masters, Business Process Leads, and Release/PMO teams to manage dependencies, remove blockers, coordinate testing, and deliver capabilities aligned with business objectives and release milestones.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business systems analysis, CRM systems, revenue operations systems, or enterprise solution delivery.
  • Proven experience with Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, or subscription lifecycle processes within an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Revenue Cloud Advanced, or comparable enterprise product configuration and pricing platforms.
  • Experience with product catalog management, SKU management, pricing configuration, discounting, bundle management, or product master data governance.
  • Hands-on experience with software license provisioning, entitlement management, or fulfillment workflows, including integrations using platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models, including usage capture, rating, overage management, and associated billing or revenue processes.
  • Understanding of integrated system flows across sales, order management, billing, accounts receivable, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional Agile delivery teams and driving complex enterprise initiatives from requirements through implementation.
  • Strong understanding of business process mapping, technical integrations, data dependencies, user stories, acceptance criteria, and system controls.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence decisions and drive alignment across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing business-as-usual support, competing priorities, and future-state transformation initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, MuleSoft, or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS subscription models, managed service providers (MSPs), usage-based billing, and customer lifecycle processes.
  • Familiarity with Kaseya One or comparable software provisioning, entitlement, and license management platforms.
  • Experience with revenue operations, billing operations, finance transformation, or enterprise business systems within a complex, integrated technology environment.
  • Experience supporting enterprise architecture modernization, legacy platform transitions, data governance initiatives, and large-scale systems migration.
  • Knowledge of revenue recognition and billing metadata requirements associated with product, pricing, usage, and subscription management.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (AI) - Veeva Quality Cloud
jobs.jd_full:
Job Title: Technical Product Manager (AI) - Veeva Quality Cloud

Job Location: Boston, MA, US

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions across the Veeva Quality Cloud suite of products. Veeva Quality Cloud accelerates the manufacturing of high-quality products to a greater number of patients. The cloud platform unifies applications, processes and partners across content management, training, Quality Management System (QMS) and QC lab solutions (LIMS). In this role, you will be an expert in the use of AI to design and build AI agents that analyze document content and intelligently extract the information to map & store them as structured data within the Veeva Quality Cloud data model (i.e. ‘Docs to Data’).

What You'll Do

    • Hands-on design and development of AI agents focused on ‘Docs to Data’ across the Veeva Quality Cloud
    • Design and deliver production AI Agent applications including data flow, orchestration, and prompts
    • Work with engineering and UX to automate key business processes using AI
    • Assist with AI Agent evaluations
    • Present feature capabilities and value to internal and external stakeholders

Requirements

    • 5+ years of enterprise SaaS product management, engineering, or technical consulting experience, with at least 2+ years focused on AI/ML applications
    • Experience with data flow design, algorithm selection, and model integration
    • Coding skills in Python and hands-on experience with AI Frameworks and APIs
    • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLMs, and prompt engineering
    • Strong collaboration skills for working with engineering, UX design, and application product management teams
    • Excellent communication skills to work with non-technical stakeholders
    • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with little direct supervision
    • Must be based in or within one hour of the Eastern Time zone
    • Must be able to travel 20%

Nice to Have

    • Experience in a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role
    • Experience in Life Sciences
    • Experience building products on application development platforms
    • Experience building software for regulated industries
    • Experience interacting with customers and internal teams remotely and across geographies

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $75,000 - $165,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Job Title: Senior Product Manager - Safety

Job Location: Toronto, Canada

jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We’re building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we’re just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow’s legal team runs on ServiceNow. NDAs, procurement contracts, conflict checks, and requests for legal advice all move through our own platform.

You’ll own a portfolio of AI and platform initiatives for our legal technology team within the Global Business Services Experience team. The goal: give attorneys and legal professionals their time back. Fewer routine requests land on their desks. The ones that do get answered faster. And legal data is structured so AI agents can do useful work with it.

You won’t hand requirements to engineering and move on. You’ll prototype with AI, prove what works, and partner with our Product organization to turn the best of what we build into features our customers use. This is where we put AI to work for people, starting with our own.

What you get to do in this role:

Own the roadmap

  • Own a multi-quarter roadmap for legal AI and platform initiatives across Contract Management Pro, Legal Service Delivery, and connected systems
  • Plan each quarter in epics, then deliver through iterative development, testing, and production release
  • Write epics, user stories, technical spikes, acceptance criteria, and solution approach documents that engineers can build from
  • Prioritize a busy backlog with clear tradeoffs, and say no when it matters
  • Lead discovery with legal and business teams, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and translate them into prioritized product requirements and measurable outcomes

Build AI agents legal teams trust

  • Design and deliver AI agents for legal work, such as advice and counsel recommendations, contract redlining against our standard terms, request intake and triage, and contract review
  • Decide how agents retrieve knowledge, when people review their output, and how feedback improves them over time
  • Use out-of-the-box and Now Assist capabilities first, and build custom only when the platform can’t do the job
  • Build quick prototypes to test AI performance and get stakeholder agreement before committing to a full build
  • Make sure anything headed to production gets engineering review and hardening
  • Prove it works
  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets, and pass thresholds before any AI feature reaches production
  • Run model and vendor evaluations without locking into a single model or provider
  • Build and own value models (hours saved, request volume, cycle time) and report AI impact to senior leadership monthly and quarterly
  • Establish baselines and measure adoption, cycle time, quality, and realized productivity improvements after launch

Partner across ServiceNow

  • Partner with our Product organization to co-develop and validate enhancements for potential inclusion in customer-facing platform releases

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.jd_full:
About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we’re building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You’ll own the crew’s strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won’t receive a roadmap and execute it. You’ll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you’ll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you’ll be up to

  • Owning your crew’s product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.
  • Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.
  • Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.
  • Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren’t great ones.
  • Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.
  • Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.
  • Bringing your customers’ needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.
  • Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team’s code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you’ll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you’ve run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

  • Independent product ownership. You’ve owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.
  • Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.
  • Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.
  • Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.
  • Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.
  • An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

  • Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.
  • Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.
  • Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don’t tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We’d still love to hear from you.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschlandticket.
  • Team connection. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible.

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Water)
jobs.jd_full:
The Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Water) delivers Havenpark’s water infrastructure projects, including water treatment plants, wells, storage tanks, distribution lines, and irrigation systems, on budget and by their budgeted completion dates. The role owns each assigned project from scope definition through closeout, managing the engineers and contractors to completion. The water portfolio currently includes about 55 open projects totaling $9.8 million.

This role is accountable for completion. Community managers and Regional Vice Presidents (RVP) stay informed and partner on access and communication, but they are not responsible for completing the work. The Sr. Utilities Program Manager sets priorities and selects projects and also owns compliance, operators, and utility emergency response, so this role can stay focused on projects.

On critical projects and others that need an engineer for design and construction, the position manages the engineers and holds them to scope, schedule, and cost. It reinforces Havenpark’s values and purpose-driven culture of creating caring communities.

Project Planning & Delivery

  • Own a portfolio of water projects from scope definition through closeout, finishing each on budget and on schedule, with no projects past due.
  • Define scope fully before bidding, including what’s in and out, so contractors price and plan the real work and change requests are rare.
  • Build the plan up front: lead times, agency review times, access and seasonal constraints, and potential start delays. Start early enough to finish on time.
  • Maintain project plans, milestones, and budgeted completion dates in project management software; flag risks early and recover projects that fall behind.
  • Visit project sites as needed, and verify that work is actually complete and ready before marking a project complete.

Contractor & Engineer Management

  • Manage engineers and contractors to completion on every assigned project, holding them accountable for quality, safety, schedule, and cost.
  • Walk contractors through the scope and schedule before they start and confirm their understanding in writing; manage bids, contracts, and change orders; and compare change requests against the survey, scope, and drawings before approving.
  • Engage engineers for design and construction on critical projects and other projects that require engineering; define their scopes of work, review designs and cost estimates, and review invoices and progress reports.
  • Select and develop a reliable bench of contractors in the assigned region and replace those who do not perform, with documented reasons.

Permitting & Regulatory Coordination

  • Coordinate water project permits, plan reviews, and approvals with state agencies and local authorities, in partnership with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager.
  • Build agency review time into every plan, respond quickly to agency comments, and confirm approvals and conditions are cleared before work starts.
  • Ensure projects are built and documented to meet regulatory requirements, and hand off completed systems and documentation to the Sr. Utilities Program Manager for ongoing compliance.

Budget, Cost Control & Reporting

  • Develop project budgets and cost forecasts; track actual costs against the budget and report variances early.
  • Report project status, past-due projects, risks, and needed decisions to the VP of Capital Projects and the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on an agreed cadence.
  • Support annual utility budget planning with project scopes and cost estimates.

Collaboration & Business Partnership

  • Keep community managers and RVPs informed about schedules, access, and anything that affects their communities, serving as a single point of contact so they don’t have to field calls from multiple parties.
  • Partner with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on project priorities, sequencing, and capital needs identified through system health and compliance findings.
  • Stay on the shared outage communication thread and assist as needed; the Sr. Utilities Program Manager leads utility emergency response.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and care consistent with Havenpark’s purpose of creating caring communities.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental science, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience: 3-5 years managing utility infrastructure projects, specifically water.
  • Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred, not required.
  • Skills & Knowledge:
  • Water treatment, storage, distribution, and irrigation project delivery, from design through construction and closeout
  • Drinking water regulations, agency plan review, and permitting
  • Construction contracts, bidding, change orders, and vendor management
  • Project budgeting, forecasting, and cost tracking
  • Project management software and scheduling tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-motivated, organized problem solver able to manage multiple projects and priorities independently
  • High learning agility; works well with all levels of the organization and is a strong team player
  • Physical Demands & Additional Requirements Primarily an office-based position with typical physical demands related to extended computer and phone use, including long periods of sitting, and periods of walking and standing at project sites in outdoor conditions. Travel is expected about once per quarter to visit large projects, with occasional additional travel for meetings.

Able to pass a criminal background check.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Program Manager, USACE Latin America & Caribbean
jobs.jd_full:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

Dexis is seeking a Program Manager to provide strategic leadership and oversight for a U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America & Caribbean District program supporting project management and technical support services across Central and South America. The program will support USACE’s oversight of large- and small-scale capital infrastructure programs, including critical public works, disaster recovery, national security cooperation, and strategic infrastructure initiatives.

The Program Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team supporting program and project management, project controls, acquisition and contract management, and specialized technical services. The position requires senior-level leadership in a high-pressure environment characterized by multiple concurrent priorities, compressed timelines, evolving funding and operational requirements, and complex international operating conditions.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience managing large-scale, complex U.S. Government programs and portfolios exceeding $1 billion, with demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and oversee complex infrastructure programs. Direct USACE project management experience and experience managing programs in Central and South America are highly desired.

This position is a scalable 1099 consulting engagement, with the level of effort varying based on awarded task orders and program requirements. This position is contingent upon award.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and overall management oversight for program implementation and multiple concurrent BPA call orders.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams supporting complex infrastructure, engineering, program management, project controls, acquisition-support, and technical-support requirements throughout Central and South America.

  • Oversee program and project management activities across the full project lifecycle, including planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, and closeout.

  • Develop strategic plans, establish management priorities, coordinate internal teams, and ensure effective integration across program task areas.

  • Oversee program performance against schedules, budgets, deliverables, and performance requirements.

  • Ensure effective coordination between program management, project controls, acquisition and contract-management support, and specialized technical teams.

  • Establish and maintain effective, transparent communication with USACE leadership, the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), and other Government stakeholders.

  • Identify, track, and manage programmatic, schedule, cost, operational, and performance risks, and oversee development and implementation of appropriate mitigation measures.

  • Guide the program’s response to multiple, competing urgent priorities and short-notice Government requirements in a dynamic international environment.

  • Oversee staffing and deployment of qualified personnel across Latin America and the Caribbean and support the program’s ability to scale staffing in response to changing call-order requirements.

  • Support coordination of specialized subject matter expertise for urgent requirements, including activities requiring rapid mobilization to foreign, remote, or challenging project locations.

  • Ensure program activities and deliverables meet applicable U.S. Government and USACE requirements and quality standards.

  • Provide increased leadership and coordination for strategic active call orders or when designated major projects require intensive oversight, including travel to San Juan, Puerto Rico and locations across Central and South America, as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Engineering, Business Management, Construction Management, or a related field.

  • Minimum of twenty (20) years of experience managing large-scale, complex government programs, with demonstrated experience leading a portfolio of projects valued in excess of $1B.

  • Direct experience managing Project Management contracts or programs for USACE.

  • Demonstrated experience managing infrastructure, engineering, or security assistance programs in Central and South America.

  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams in high-pressure, short-deadline environments characterized by shifting political, funding, and operational priorities.

  • Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required.

  • Excellent English and Spanish communication skills preferred.

  • Ability to travel frequently to Central and South America preferred.

Benefits

Dexis offers benefits to support employees’ health, financial security, and well-being. The benefits outlined below are for full-time, US-based positions only. These benefits include:

  • Medical and prescription drug coverage: A choice of three UnitedHealthcare medical plans, with coverage options for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Dental insurance: Dental coverage for employees and eligible dependents, including preventive, basic, major, and orthodontic services, subject to plan limits.
  • Company-paid vision insurance: Vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, with premiums paid in full by Dexis.
  • Employer-funded health reimbursement arrangement (HRA): Employees who enroll in the Silver HRA medical plan receive an employer-funded HRA to help pay eligible in-network deductible expenses.
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance: Basic life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Optional supplemental insurance: Voluntary supplemental life and AD&D insurance options, including life insurance options for eligible dependents.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Company-paid access to confidential counseling and legal and financial support resources for employees and their families.
  • Health and wellness resources: Virtual care, behavioral health resources, and wellness programs available through the medical plan.
  • Benefits assistance: Personalized support with benefit enrollment, coverage questions, claims, and finding providers through the Employee Care Center.

Participation, coverage, and employee contributions are subject to applicable benefit plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

If you are passionate about this opportunity, apply now!

Only those applicants who meet the above criteria will be contacted for interview.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Project Manager

The Opportunity: As the Project Manager, you will navigate the execution of projects like a skilled sailor at sea. You assist with charting the course by translating client briefs into clear, actionable project plans, steering through the complexities from inception to completion. With a keen eye on budgets and schedules, you ensure the ship stays on course, raising the flag if turbulent waters are upon us and looking for the solution to get us through.

Your teamwork as a crew member ensures smooth sailing by consistently managing internal team communications to deliver the highest quality work. You can adeptly adjust the sails, regularly soliciting and acting on client feedback to ensure every project reaches its destination effectively.

What kind of person would that be?

Organized and on top of it. Someone people often describe as “dependable” and “reliable”. Flexible, not like Yoga, but open to learning. An active listener (which is a thing). A human, who likes people and forges strong relationships. Assertive and confident when identifying and responding to issues that might put a project at risk. Easily earns trust. Likes to have fun, a real plus. You know when and how to reach out, and can adapt your style to effectively manage up, down, and across.

What you’ll be part of:

One of the fastest growing integrated marketing/PR agencies on this planet. Offices and opportunities across the globe. Fantastic clients and a robust pipeline. Talented people at every position. Kind people. Leadership that cares about your success and provides career mentorship. A commitment to workable processes and taking care to do things correctly the first time. An agency that cares about work culture and gives you a voice in it.

Why Join FINN Partners?

  • Competitive salary, benefits package, and a commitment to work-life balance.
  • A culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration.
  • Career advancement opportunities in a fast-growing company.
  • A wellness subsidy.
  • A manager that provides consistent 1:1 check ins, reviews, and culture-building opportunities to connect with people across the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Strong attention to detail in all aspects of projects and communication.
  • Delivers professional & friendly interactions with client & team.
  • Act as a communication hub for project team, partners, vendors, and clients.
  • Produces clear, concise, organized and actionable written documents and correspondence, both internal and external. Including but not limited to QA, updating status documentation and time reports.
  • Adept at problem solving and/or knowing who to go to for help.
  • Understand the client’s business and project management systems
  • Ability to use agency systems and follow established processes and workflow.
  • Schedule and attend key touch-point meetings, both internal and external. Ensuring the team is prepared with a call agenda and additional required information.

Qualifications:

  • Prior experience as a project manager in an agency setting or comparable is helpful.
  • 1-3 years of experience in project management.
  • Bachelor’s degree is a plus.

Anticipated Salary: $55,000 - $65,000

Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, location, and level at which the candidate is hired.

#LI-DS1

To Apply:

Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary in

$US Dollars. While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to

those with whom we have a greater interest.

About FINN

Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has grown from about $24 million in fees to nearly $200 million in fees over ten years, becoming one of the fastest growing independent public relations agencies in the world. The full-service marketing and communications company’s record setting pace is a result of organic growth and integrating new companies and new people into the FINN world through a common philosophy. With more than 1,300 professionals across 35 offices, FINN provides clients with global access and capabilities in the Americas, Europe and Asia. FINN Partners clients are also supported through longstanding partner agencies and its membership in the PROI network of leading agencies around the world.

Headquartered in New York, FINN has offices in: Abu Dhabi, Atlanta, Bangalore, Bangkok, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Delhi, Denver, Detroit, Dublin, Fort Lauderdale, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Honolulu, Jerusalem, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Madison, Manila, Mumbai, Munich, Nashville, Orange County, Paris, Portland, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Shanghai, Singapore, Washington D.C. and Yangon. About Anthology FINN Partners Anthology FINN Partners is Hawaii’s only integrated marketing and communications firm with a full-service market research firm in house. With a full-time staff of 80 professionals, Anthology has enjoyed the privilege of working with Hawaii’s top corporate, nonprofit and government clients. Headquartered in Honolulu, we have a proven track record of executing successful integrated communications campaigns, and a deep bench of best-in-practice professionals across all disciplines needed to market in today’s environment.
